'''yodaindahouze You'd Rather Profit By This than see your bounty hunters slaughtered''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[yodaindahouze]]
* '''Published:''' 3 September 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 Profit yodaindahouze LS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

tatooine. what a place. can be quite a stir when "court" and "profit" decks go head to head. well here's a go at my "profit or be destroyed". bounty hunters beware.

== Strategy ==

ok then.

1.if you receive luke w/ lightsaber in hand first, play him on the effect to make him immune to attrition. if you get master luke or luke's back play him instead.

2.get as much out there as you can to take over audience chamber. droids and hoatd should help with attrition.

3. once objective is flipped, get a gift out there to take down opponent's force drains and battle destiny.

4.make sure to have a droid at an adjacent site to the action so that you can use arc welder if you are captured.

5. if sarlacc is out, mount enough power to battle and beat it. if rancor is on table use yoda's gimer stick to stop its attacks on your characters.

6. mechanical failure is there if opponent tries anything with combat vehicles.

i know there's nothing in space. this deck was made for taking out opponent's force quickly so no space power can be accomplished. please remember when rating this deck that it is made mainly to fight a "court" deck.
